card.name: Words after interfere, determined, inhibit
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs right after a verb of interfering, determining or inhibiting, such as 'interfere with', 'determined that', 'reversibly inhibit'. Mostly in drug-label interaction and test-interference text.

modes.label: After interfere
modes.description: The word 'with' or 'the' following 'interfere' in lab-test interference statements.
modes.example: Quinine may interfere<< with>> urine qualitative

modes.label: After determined
modes.description: A linking word right after 'determined' or 'determined by' in a statement of findings.
modes.example: An investigation board determined that<< a>> large piece of foam fell from the shuttle

modes.label: Inhibit verb
modes.description: The verb 'inhibit' after 'reversibly' in somatostatin analog text.
modes.example: Somatostatin analogs reversibly<< inhibit>> secretion of pancreatic enzymes and bile acids,

card.writes: It slightly favors words like unique and distinct, so the link to the output is weak.
card.plain: It lights up on the small word or verb that comes right after phrases like 'interfere with' or 'determined that'.
